official_site_checks: Official public series pages expose Associated Name(s) and Related Series(s), which are retained in the Aidoku details description with relationship labels when present. Live /hot-updates cards expose chapter links and cover-host series ULIDs; /series/<ULID> resolves without a slug. Official public /search HTML exposes tri-state Official Translation, Anime Adaptation, and Adult Content controls. Regression tests verify each filter routes its Any/True/False state to the matching form field; Cloudflare challenge pages are rejected across search, details, chapter-list, reader and Home requests rather than accepted as empty results.
